cases.title: After pit P3 is moved and a new pipe's open end is stretched, CDCHECK still names everything in words: no raw handle, no CE-CIV id, and the open pipe end line reads in words
cases.plan_item: BUG-372 the STRETCH and MOVE part (PR 1835, switch checks.cdcheckLinesShowNoInternalIds); the part R22 leaves out
cases.expected: After SETUP-R47 (pit P3 moved up 2000 mm, new pit P8 at 150000,-80000, new pipe to the open end 170000,-80000) the open end is stretched 2000 mm east with a crossing window round 170000,-80000. The IL 17.78 text (the 1 in 100 grade follows the 2000 mm stretch: 18.000 less 0.22 m) then sits within 800 mm of 172000,-80000. CDCHECK prints its '[CE] CDCHECK:' summary and at least one line saying a pipe end 'is not connected'. No command-line line since the case began holds 'handle ', 'CE-CIV-PIPE-', 'CE-CIV-PIT-' or a '\U+' escape code.
cases.why_not_unit: The lines are worded from the real drawing after live MOVE and STRETCH edits, and are only seen on the live command line.
not_automated: The 'no clear spot ... (on the block Drawing Border)' wording after a MOVE is not part of PR 1835 and is only recorded (FULL history tail), not judged.
The Csv answer of CDCHECK, the Checks palette (BUG-753, BUG-814) and the schedule footer (BUG-360) are not read. A grip-stretch with the mouse is not driven; only the typed STRETCH.
DERIVED, not yet seen on a run: the STRETCH prompt chain, that the IL text at the open end follows the stretched end, and that the open-end line holds the words 'is not connected' after the stretch.
